audience: Developers and documentation writers who have just found Cueflow and want to make narrated UI tutorials without recording video. They know HTML and a terminal; they have never used Cueflow.
tone: Direct, calm and friendly. Short sentences, impersonal or second person ("you").
rules: Show only what Cueflow does today; no promise about future features
Use the demo kit (the upload tutorial) as the running example; fake data only
Studio screens are captured from a Studio running on a copy of examples/demo-kit
Say the product name as Cueflow and the editor as Studio
